claims: The Artemis II mission uses the Space Launch System (SLS) Block 1 rocket.
The Space Launch System (SLS) Block 1 rocket stands 322 feet (98 meters) tall.
The Space Launch System (SLS) Block 1 rocket is higher than the Statue of Liberty.
The Space Launch System (SLS) Block 1 rocket is the most powerful rocket launched with humans.
The Space Launch System (SLS) Block 1 rocket produces 8.8 million pounds of thrust.
The Space Launch System (SLS) Block 1 rocket's thrust is produced by 4 engines + 2 solid boosters.
The Artemis II crew operates inside the Orion capsule.
The Orion capsule features 330 cubic feet (approximately 9 cubic meters) of habitat space.
The Orion capsule volume is 330 cubic feet (9.3 m³).
The Orion capsule has a 5.02-meter (16.5 ft) diameter.
The Orion capsule has a 3.3-meter (10.8 ft) length.
The Space Launch System (SLS) Block 1 rocket weighs 5.75 million pounds (2,604 tonnes) at liftoff.
The Apollo-era Saturn V is 363 feet tall.
SpaceX’s Starship is ~400 feet tall.
The Space Shuttle is 184 feet tall.
The Space Launch System (SLS) Block 1 rocket is shorter than the Apollo-era Saturn V.
The Space Launch System (SLS) Block 1 rocket is smaller than SpaceX’s Starship.
The Space Launch System (SLS) Block 1 rocket is taller than the Space Shuttle.
The Orion capsule is designed to provide room for four astronauts.
The Artemis II mission lasts 10 days around the Moon.
